subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

MUNDANE
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mundane"** means something that is ordinary, commonplace, or lacking excitement; it often refers to the routine aspects of life. (साधारण)

 
 
• **Example: **She longed for an adventure to escape her **mundane** existence.
 
 
 
• **"Ordinary" **refers to something that is normal and not special or different in any way; it is often used to describe everyday things. (साधारण)
 
 
• **Example: **He led an **ordinary life**, with a regular job and a happy family.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'mundane' **is **'ordinary'**.

Therefore, the correct synonym of** Mundane** is **Ordinary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Abnormal **(असामान्य): Something that deviates from what is standard, usual, or expected.

 
 
• **Example:** His behavior was considered abnormal by his peers.
 
 
 
• **Wonderful **(शानदार): Inspiring delight, pleasure, or admiration; extremely good.
 
 
• **Example: **We had a wonderful time at the beach.
 
 
 
• **Exciting** (रोमांचक): Causing great enthusiasm and eagerness.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was so exciting that I couldn't take my eyes off the screen.
